readerValueVsCompetitors.reason: It gives an ordered diagnosis with a test the reader can run tonight on their own machine (roast date, basket, cap-level dose, time to first flow against the manual's numbers). It explains that the dual-wall basket works "regardless of the grind, dose and tamp pressure or freshness", gives the correct burr direction, and has a stopping rule that leads to one purchase. The top results are forum threads with conflicting tips, plus an SCG post that points the burr the wrong way.

distinctivenessVoice.reason: It opens with "Don't buy anything yet." It commits to one view, sets its own rule for metal contact ("My rule, which is my judgement and not the manual's"), and has a real "When I'd choose differently" section with three distinct cases.

honestyAboutLimits.reason: "What the booklet doesn't say" lists the four unknowns once, plainly. The parts listing is labelled "a parts listing, not a manufacturer spec", and the owner report as "a single report, not a spec". The methods section says no testing was done, no one contacted support and no grinders were researched.

evidenceIntegrity.reason: Every factual statement maps to a claim ID: dial ranges, the 5–20 days, the basket quote, 22–33 lb and 16–19 g, flow timings, troubleshooting causes, the warranty wording and the PDC part numbers. "A machine that can't grind fine enough... could reasonably count" is an inference, but it reads clearly as one. The kg conversion is added by the writer, and it is correct.

topicFit.reason: It delivers the brief's thesis in order: free checks, then cleaning, then the upper burr toward FINE, then the date code and the manufacturer, then a separate grinder. It respects the leaveOut list: no '6', no shims, no grinder picks, no prices.

competitorComparison.weGiveThatTheyDont: An order of checks backed by the manual, with a stopping point. The thread gives scattered replies (inner burr steps, burr clash, light roasts, buy a grinder), and a reader can't tell which one applies to them.

It turns that thread's one fix (clean the grinder, move the inner burr to 1, ask for a free burr) into a repeatable procedure. It adds the basket and dose checks the thread skips, and it labels the fix as one owner's report.

The correct direction for fast shots (toward FINE, where SCG says coarser), the checks to do before touching the burr, the date-code part check, the warranty route, and when to buy a separate grinder.

optionalImprovements: Before publishing (human or research item): publish the grinder-for-barista-express-and-pro guide, or both guide references render as plain text and the ending promises a guide the reader can't open. Once grinder research covering both markets exists, add those picks to offerIds, which is what the owner asked for.
